voiceover: Seven new arguments on Apologia Daily — on who Jesus is, and on the Trinity — many drawn from Paul, the earliest Christian writer. In the Jesus section: The Full Humanity of Christ. Did Paul invent Jesus's divinity? Did the first Christians worship Jesus as God? Is Jesus Yahweh? The divine-name argument. Christ Before Bethlehem. And why a crucified Messiah? And in the Trinity section: was the Trinity invented in the fourth century? Every card starts in plain English, with the key claims set out. Then The Case, Plainly — the positive case, before the deep dive. Then a deeper dive — the full case, with the objections it faces. Tap any line to see the texts, what they do and do not claim, and the honest limit. Each argument has its own fully cited deep-dive essay. On every essay, two AI tutors. Ask AI Tutor answers your questions. Teach me this walks you through the argument, one question at a time. Then make it yours. Each one has a Mastery Track: understand it, explain it, drill it, defend it. Not just reading about Jesus — being ready to give a reason for the hope you have, with gentleness and respect. Explore them at apologiadaily.com.
